description:
Company Description MUNG is a boutique law firm founded in Hong Kong in 2018, focusing on emerging technology sectors such as blockchain, AI, DeSci, art tech, travel tech, and intellectual property law.

MUNG routinely advises on complex transactions and disputes, including IPOs, M&A, arbitration, fraud, and IP, helping clients navigate innovation and digital transformation.

The firm has expanded its network to Singapore and Tokyo, providing cross-border legal advice in corporate, commercial, and dispute resolution matters.

The team is passionate about cutting-edge industries and committed to delivering practical, forward-looking legal solutions.

Role Description This is a full-time, on-site role based in Hong Kong SAR for both a Hong Kong Solicitor and a Trainee Solicitor.

The Solicitor will handle a range of corporate, commercial, and civil matters, including drafting and reviewing contracts, preparing transaction documents, managing regulatory filings, and advising clients in technology and innovation sectors.

The Trainee Solicitor will assist with legal research, drafting, document review, and case preparation, while rotating through different practice areas and working closely with supervising solicitors.

Both roles will be demanding.

Qualifications

- Strong legal research, analytical, and drafting skills, with the ability to produce clear, well-structured legal documents.
- For Hong Kong Solicitor: admission as a solicitor in Hong Kong, with relevant post-qualification experience; prior exposure to technology-related matters is a plus.
- For Trainee Solicitor: completion of required legal education and professional examinations in Hong Kong.
